title: game
description: A canonical video game catalogue record for analytic reporting.

name.description: The official published title of the video game as printed on the box art and store page.

releaseYear.description: The four-digit calendar year in which the game was first released to the public.

developer.description: The studio or development house that designed and built the game.

publisher.description: The company responsible for publishing, marketing and distributing the game.

platform.description: The console or hardware system the game runs on.

genres.description: The gameplay genres or categories the game belongs to.

criticScore.description: The aggregate professional critic review score for the game, out of one hundred.

ESRB.description: The ESRB content maturity age rating assigned to the game.

summary.description: A short prose synopsis describing the game's premise, setting and gameplay.

playerModes.description: The supported player modes, such as single-player, co-op or multiplayer.

ownerStudioCountry.description: The country in which the game's developer studio is headquartered.
